title: ittcsecscan version --json output
description: Build identity of an ittcsecscan binary. Fields that cannot be determined are reported as "unknown", never guessed.

development_build.description: True unless the binary was produced by the release build with an injected version.

build_time.description: Derived from SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (release) or VCS commit time, never from the build machine's clock.
